title: Fundamental Mathematics in the Age of AI -- The Residue, the Journey, and the Ecology
summary: Large language models have begun refuting long-standing conjectures and solving long-open problems. The introspection this has prompted about the future of mathematical discovery is well under way, and the anxiety accompanying it legitimate -- but both, we claim, are attached to the wrong loss. What machines now produce is the countable part of mathematics -- theorems, proofs, refutations -- which was always the work's residue, not its product. The distinction is old, and not economic: a result can be taken in its finished essence, or in the operations that engendered it. The product is…
